notes:
VDBackup v1.11

New
- Back up /data/adb itself - the root environment (modules, their data and configs), all of it or a subtree you pick from a file tree, and restore it the same way. Each file keeps its original owner and SELinux context, so root keeps working. Advanced; only what you choose is included.

Reliability
- A long batch no longer stalls on one slow app - VDBackup records why and moves on.
- A partial batch now says why it stopped: how many apps succeeded, the reason the rest failed, and how much room is left.
- An app running an active VPN is backed up while it keeps running, instead of being force-stopped.
- Long backups pace themselves to avoid overheating, and resume on their own (a new switch in Settings turns it off).

Fixes
- A blocked app comes back blocked after a restore, even on ROMs that keep the block only in memory. (#9)
- A backup saved to a local destination no longer also keeps a copy in internal storage.
- Updating from your root manager keeps the edition you installed (lite, full, or your device's architecture).
- The "Updates" panel is readable in the light theme; notifications appear in Indonesian and Ukrainian.

Interface
- The heaviest sections across Settings, Destinations, Backups and Schedule are now collapsible cards you open only when you need them.
- Settings save the moment you change them - no separate Save step.
- "Check for updates" and the update notice moved to the Updates tab.
